note: Iowa DNR state park on Rock Creek Lake, east of Kellogg. The campground fills a peninsula on the lake's east shore: electric loops to the north, a non-electric loop to the south, and back-in rows on both loops facing the water. Marina concession (mid-April to mid-October) rents pontoons, fishing boats, canoes and kayaks; swim beach, boat ramps, jetties and 8+ miles of multi-use trails. --Claude
summary: Lakefront confirmed: official site photos and imagery show the west-side rows (about 28-42) and the south non-electric loop's shore sites (about 151-156 and 163-167) on open lawn 10-40 m from the water with no road between. Sites corrected 196 -> 170 (98 electric, 69 non-electric, 3 group/buddy, from ReserveAmerica). FCFS corrected some_sites -> never (100% reservable). Added pull-throughs, flush toilets, potable water, camp store and booking link; 50-amp, showers and dump confirmed. Fees left as stored (DNR 2026 rate sheet).
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront kept): ReserveAmerica's 'Near Water' icon reads 'no' on every one of the 170 sites, and the per-site details carry no Proximity to Water field, so the tag is unpopulated here, not a finding. The DNR says 'Several campsites sit on the water's edge'. The 1/2025 map puts back-ins 27-42 (electric) on the outside of the west loop road, between it and the lake, and non-electric 151-156 and 163-167 on the outside of the south loop. Imagery: west-row pad ends ~10-25 m from the shore across open mown lawn; south-loop pads ~35-40 m across open lawn. Official photos: site 36 backs onto open lawn running to the lake; site 153 is a grass site right on the shore. About 25 candidate sites in all. The boat ramp at the north-west sits beside sites 28-31, not in front of them.
